metadata.title: Business Observability Platform: Buyer's Guide
metadata.meta_description: What a business observability platform must do, from event ingestion to KPI mapping, alerting and governance, plus a weighted scorecard for scoring vendors.
metadata.h1: Business observability platform: what to look for and how to evaluate one
metadata.author: kieran-lovell

qa_findings.note: Read /platform/ (product overview, no buyer evaluation method) and existing blog posts; BO-02 is a vendor-neutral evaluation guide with scorecard. WebSearch 'business observability platform' shows vendor product pages and definitions, no buyer scorecard.

Network egress blocked in this session (dynatrace.com, docs.dynatrace.com, ibm.com, gartner.com, wikipedia, opentelemetry.org all fail DNS), so no brief references could be verified. Article therefore cites no external URLs and makes no third-party factual claims.
Panoptes capabilities phrased as design intent; automated execution flagged as vision; no customers or results.
All internal links exist as routes; checked by check:links.
Written in British English; no automated spellcheck run.
